cards.front: Improved-Neubauer large-square volume and the concentration formula
cards.back: 1 mm × 1 mm × 0.1 mm = 0.1 µL = 10⁻⁴ mL, so viable cells/mL = mean unstained count per large square × 10,000 × dilution factor. Check the depth marked on your own chamber.

cards.front: Boundary rule, corners and the order of decisions
cards.back: Include cells touching the top or left line; exclude any cell touching the bottom or right line, even at a corner. Decide the boundary first, then the stain; excluded cells enter neither tally.

cards.front: Poisson counting uncertainty and what it leaves out
cards.back: About 100/√N percent for N cells counted: 100 cells give 10%, 400 give 5%. It excludes mixing, dilution, loading and classification errors, which replicate agreement cannot reveal.

cards.front: What trypan-blue viability does and does not show
cards.back: The fraction of counted cells with intact membranes at the moment of counting, read in serum-free solution within minutes. Not growth, function, phenotype, sterility or overall health.
